subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should OpenClaw resolve this as docs/help for the existing TUI newline behavior, or add a public TUI keybinding/config bridge for Enter, Ctrl+Enter, and Shift+Enter preferences?
rationale: The basic newline behavior is already dependency-backed, but exposing configurable TUI send/newline keys would add a new public config/API surface under a high-bar compatibility policy.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Add TUI docs and /help coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send as the default.

options.title: Approve Configurable Keybindings
options.body: Add a narrow TUI keybinding preference surface with schema/help/docs and tests for default and configured send/newline behavior.

options.title: Defer The Config Surface
options.body: Keep the issue open as product backlog until maintainers decide whether TUI keybindings should be configurable at all.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Add TUI docs and /help coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue's remaining scope and has recent history in the relevant TUI docs, commands, and runtime paths.
